name: Chinese Communists (Jinggangshan and Jiangxi soviet bases)

predecessors.name: Kuomintang (Guangzhou and Nanjing Nationalist government)
predecessors.text: the Jinggang Mountains on the Jiangxi-Hunan border, where Mao Zedong's group 'established a base in the remote Jinggang Mountains'

successors.name: Communist Party of China (Chinese Soviet Republic, Shaan-Gan-Ning Border Region and Liberated Areas)
successors.text: the Jiangxi-Fujian soviet area around Ruijin, where the Chinese Soviet Republic was proclaimed on 7 November 1931

ledger.x: 1928: the Communists hold a base in the Jinggang Mountains.
1930: the Communists extend to the Jiangxi-Fujian border around Ruijin.
1931: the Chinese Soviet Republic is proclaimed at Ruijin on 7 November.
ledger.cpn: Communist Party of China (Chinese Soviet Republic, Shaan-Gan-Ning Border Region and Liberated Areas)

wars.name: Encirclement campaigns against the Jiangxi Soviet
wars.outcome: The Soviet 'survived the first, second and third encirclement campaigns thanks to the use of flexible guerrilla tactics'; the fifth campaign (1933) and the fall of Ruijin (10 November 1934) belong to the next dossier.

certainty.note: Guerrilla bases in the mountains: the pages give no boundary at all; Ruijin and the Jinggang Mountains are the only points.
